We can however consider its restriction to objects in the image of Fam(B̄), and deduce fully-faithfulness for some of its local functors: ▶ Lemma 50. Let X, Y : Fam0 (SetBundle). If all bundles in X have connected bases, then the local functor Σ1 : Fam1 (X, Y ) → SetBundle(Σ0 (X), Σ0 (Y )) is fully faithful. Proof. The proof proceeds by showing that there is an equivalence of 2-cells. The assumption . on connectedness is used as follows: Recall that X = (J, λj. To characterize identifications of these maps, it is necessary show, given morphisms u, v : J → K, that the function u(j) = v(j) → (Bj → u(j) = v(j)) constant in Bj is an equivalence. But this follows from connectedness of Bj and the fact that u(j) = v(j) is a proposition [20, 7.5.9]. ◀
